meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把零散素材剪成品牌片、混剪或多场景长视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把手头素材剪成完整视频却找不到合适模板
copy.tagline_en: Cut brand reels, montages, and multi-scene videos from raw footage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn raw clips into a finished video without a ready template

howto.what: 它会为一个视频项目编写或编辑 HyperFrames 合成:多场景长片、品牌片、蒙太奇、静态循环、标题卡、素材混剪等。它先看 BRIEF.md 和项目文件判断状态,再按阶段读取对应参考资料,最后经检查点产出并渲染。
howto.when: 当没有专门工作流适配,或 BRIEF.md 中 flow 设为 companion 时接管;全新创建要先经 /hyperframes 路由;短片、无旁白的动效单元改用 motion-graphics。

say.text: 帮我做一条多场景的品牌宣传片
say.note: 先确认项目状态,再按阶段搭建合成

say.text: 把这段素材剪成蒙太奇,保留原声
say.note: 同一素材复制成多个 clip 元素并设时间范围

say.text: 用 companion 模式陪我过一遍每个场景
say.note: 先给一版完整方案,你再逐项删减

howto.what_en: It authors or edits a HyperFrames composition: multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, static loops, title cards, footage remixes. It reads project state first, loads stage references, then builds and renders at checkpoints.
howto.when_en: Triggers when no specialized workflow fits or BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Fresh creation routes through /hyperframes first; short unnarrated motion-only units use motion-graphics instead.

say_en.text: Build me a multi-scene brand reel
say_en.note: Checks project state, then scaffolds the composition

say_en.text: Cut this footage into a montage, keep the original audio
say_en.note: Duplicates the source into clip elements with set ranges

say_en.text: Let's go companion mode and go through every scene
say_en.note: Offers a full treatment you then trim down
